pages.text: A reaction goes at the rate constant $(thing)k = A·e^(−Eₐ/RT)$() (Arrhenius): ten degrees warmer and many go twice as fast. The Chemical Reactor's console runs on it.$(br2)The feeds for heavy chemistry: the $(item)Air Separation Unit$() boils liquid air apart into $(fluid)Nitrogen$() and $(fluid)Oxygen$(); coal and steam in the Chemical Reactor give $(fluid)Hydrogen$() (C + H₂O → CO + H₂), as does water in the Electrolytic Cell.

Every one of these is shared with the pack's other mods: a recipe that asks for the mod's Hydrogen takes Mekanism's or NuclearCraft's as readily (anything in the c:hydrogen tag) - and the same for nitrogen, oxygen, ammonia, the acids and sulfur dioxide.
